name: GSC
summary: **GSC** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] that emerged in California's Bay Area in the early 2010s. Most accounts describe it as a cross of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[durban-poison|Durban Poison]], though breeder Jigga has disputed that story without naming an alternative. He and rapper Berner later built the Cookies brand around the cut.
